claims.criterionText: The harness target gives HAR-1 a root-boundary case with content outside the component root, HAR-2 a predicate case, HAR-3 an ambiguity case with two matching hosts, and HAR-4 an action case whose effect the harness observes.
claims.reason: The charter's portal clause reaches a feature whose facts an insurance-portal route can produce. The harness target is served only by the counter fixture at spikes/ng222-app, no portal route produces its facts, and the held-out suites assert the family directly, so no portal-backed verdict is owed for this criterion.

claims.criterionText: The menu surface supplies the listbox and menu rules N23 needs, including at least one rule that fails when the attribute it reads is removed.
claims.reason: The listbox and menu surface exists only in the counter fixture, not on an insurance-portal route, so the portal clause does not reach it. The per-attribute mutation already proves the rule bites, and a portal-backed verdict would need a portal page the fixture does not have.

claims.criterionText: The fixture builds and serves, and the four shipped explainers still answer on it.
claims.reason: This criterion is about the counter fixture's own build and its four shipped explainers. No insurance-portal route produces those facts and the portal clause therefore does not reach the criterion; the recorded project Verify and the explainer pin produce the evidence the gate cites.

claims.criterionText: `npm run check` and `npm test` pass at the head.
claims.reason: An aggregate gate over the repository's own type check and test run has no page of its own, so no insurance-portal route can produce its facts and the portal clause does not reach it. The recorded project Verify at the reviewed head is the evidence the wave gate cites.
